details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: Bleichenbacher-type side-channel in RSA decryption
     - debian/patches/CVE-2018-16869-1.patch: add side-channel silent
       memeql_sec and cnd_memcpy in memeql-sec.c, cnd-memcpy.c, memops.h,
       ccm.c, examples/rsa-decrypt.c, Makefile.in, testsuite.
     - debian/patches/CVE-2018-16869-2.patch: add side-channel silent RSA
       root function _rsa_sec_compute_root and mpn_get_base256 in
       rsa-sec-compute-root.c, rsa-internal.h, gmp-glue.c, gmp-glue.h,
       Makefile.in.
     - debian/patches/CVE-2018-16869-3.patch: add side-channel silent
       PKCS#1 decoding _pkcs1_sec_decrypt in pkcs1-sec-decrypt.c,
       rsa-internal.h, Makefile.in, testsuite.
     - debian/patches/CVE-2018-16869-4.patch: add rsa_sec_decrypt and use
       the side-channel silent root in rsa_compute_root_tr and
       rsa_compute_root, and reject bad private keys early, in
       rsa-sec-decrypt.c, rsa-sign-tr.c, rsa-sign.c,
       rsa-sec-compute-root.c, rsa.h, Makefile.in, testsuite.
     - debian/patches/CVE-2018-16869-5.patch: require input in range and of
       fixed size in rsa_sec_decrypt, rsa_decrypt_tr, rsa_decrypt and
       rsa_sec_compute_root_tr, and check the message length in
       _pkcs1_sec_decrypt, in pkcs1-sec-decrypt.c, rsa-decrypt-tr.c,
       rsa-decrypt.c, rsa-sec-decrypt.c, rsa-sign-tr.c, rsa.h, testsuite.
     - debian/patches/CVE-2018-16869-6.patch: strip the PKCS#1 padding in
       rsa_decrypt and rsa_decrypt_tr with the side-channel silent
       _pkcs1_sec_decrypt_variable, in pkcs1-sec-decrypt.c,
       pkcs1-decrypt.c, rsa-decrypt-tr.c, rsa-internal.h, testsuite.
     - debian/libhogweed4.symbols, debian/libnettle6.symbols: added new
       symbols.
     - CVE-2018-16869
     - CVE-2021-3580 (the input range checks in CVE-2018-16869-5.patch)
